name: Citizenship by Registration -- Commonwealth Citizens (Residence)

requirements.blocker_text: Must be a Commonwealth citizen or a citizen of Ireland.
Requires 5 years of residence or government service immediately preceding the application (the Minister may accept as little as 12 months in special circumstances).
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 5 years of residence or government service (or as little as 12 months, at ministerial discretion for special circumstances).

requirements.blocker_text: Requires good character and adequate knowledge of the English language.

evidence_required.document: Proof of Commonwealth or Irish citizenship
Proof of 5 years' residence or government service
Oath of allegiance (Irish citizens and British protected persons only)

sources.title: Grenada Citizenship Act, Cap 54, Section 5(1) (primary legislation): registration for Commonwealth citizens and citizens of Ireland with 5 years' residence or government service immediately preceding application (12 months in special circumstances at ministerial discretion), good character, English language knowledge, oath of allegiance for Irish citizens/British protected persons

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Grenada's initial build. Parallel registration ground to gd_citizenship_by_marriage.json within the same Section 5 framework. No explicit statement was found in the Act confirming or denying whether non-Commonwealth nationals are barred from naturalisation (see gd_naturalisation.json) -- as with Saint Lucia, this is modelled as a separate, lighter-touch ground available specifically to Commonwealth/Irish citizens, not as an exclusive gate.
